name: Europa Clipper
tagline: First mission dedicated to characterising Europa's habitability
description: NASA's mission to study the habitability of Jupiter's icy moon Europa — believed to harbour a global liquid-water ocean beneath a 15-25 km ice shell, possibly the most accessible potentially-habitable environment in the solar system. Largest planetary mission spacecraft ever launched (~6000 kg). ~102-m² solar arrays generate enough power at Jupiter's distance to drive nine instruments through 49 close Europa flybys, designed to map the entire moon while limiting the spacecraft's dose in Jupiter's brutal radiation belts.
best_known_for: First mission dedicated to Europa habitability
